long_biography.plain_text:
Viktoria Lalioti's shipping interests have included shareholdings in Alcyone Shipping Co Ltd and Armada Maritime Company Limited, two Maltese companies held alongside other members of the Laliotis family. She has also owned an interest in Sea World Management and Trading, part of the family's maritime business.

Based in the Athens area, the group owns and operates merchant ships in both tanker and dry-cargo markets. Its investment strategy combines acquiring second-hand ships with commissioning newbuildings. The business maintains relationships with major charterers and shipyards as part of its approach to fleet investment and operation.
